# figma-integration

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Use for a requested Figma/code operation. Discover actual connected tools and
their prerequisites, file, and scope; do not assume a connector exists.
Choose one authoritative sync direction and map component/state/token meaning.
Reading designs does not authorize publishing. Inspect real code parity and
report missing access without automatic stack or token migrations.
